description: Get a weighted recommendation from a list of npm packages. Scores based on bundle size (25%), popularity (20%), maintenance (20%), TypeScript support (15%), dependency count (10%), and freshness (10%). Optionally specify a max bundle size or use case to adjust weights.

max_size_kb.description: Optional max acceptable gzip bundle size in KB

packages.description: Array of package names to evaluate

require_typescript.description: If true, packages without TypeScript types get penalized

use_case.description: Adjusts scoring weights for your target environment

name: recommend_package
